image_description: A white spoonbill wading in shallow, reddish-brown water. The bird is captured in profile facing right, with its distinctive long, flat, spatulate bill clearly visible. It has predominantly white plumage, a long S-curved neck, and dark legs partially submerged in the water. The background consists of blurred earthy tones, likely a riverbank or marsh edge.
